title: Mossy cascade
description: Water slides down a moss-covered rock face in deep forest shade, a bright clump of green undergrowth clinging to the ledge beside it.

title: Canyon walls in late light
description: Layered canyon cliffs catching low sun, scrub clinging to the terraces and deep shadow filling the gorge below.

title: Winter lake mirror
description: A still winter lake holding a near-perfect reflection of the clouds, framed by bare branches and a far bank of dry reeds.

title: Spanish moss over blackwater
description: Spanish moss hangs in long grey curtains from bare limbs leaning over a dark, slow river under a bright blue sky.

title: Still lake in summer woods
description: A quiet lake ringed by full summer green, the treeline doubled almost exactly in the glassy surface.

title: River bend
description: A slow river curving past a red clay bank and rock ledge, tall grass and wildflowers filling the foreground slope.

title: Below the meadow slope
description: The same river seen from higher on a mown meadow slope, woodland crowding the far bank under stacked cumulus.

title: Cairn on the granite flat
description: A stacked stone cairn standing on a broad granite outcrop, towering cumulus building over the treeline behind.

title: Creek steps
description: A woodland creek dropping through a series of low rock shelves, boulders and leaf litter crowding both banks in dappled light.

title: Beneath the roots
description: A small waterfall spilling over a rock lip directly below a tangle of exposed tree roots, water smoothing to glass in the pool beneath.

title: Mirrored from the dock
description: Cumulus clouds reflected whole in a still pond, the weathered top rail of a dock running across the bottom of the frame.

title: Cloud reflections
description: A wide bank of summer cloud doubled in the flat surface of a wooded pond, treeline meeting its own reflection at the far shore.

title: Granite slab
description: A broad granite slab in the foreground drops away to a churning, silt-brown river, a bleached deadfall caught midstream.

title: Sun through the canopy
description: Sun bursts through creekside trees in a hard star, water running shallow over rock ledges toward the camera.

title: Mackerel sky
description: A rippled mackerel sky spread over a bare granite outcrop, the sun burning through a thin gap near the horizon.

title: Cairn against the sun
description: A stacked stone cairn silhouetted on open rock with the sun directly behind it, scattered cloud running to the treeline.

title: Niagara from the water
description: A boat-level pass along the base of the falls, the full width of the cataract pouring into churning green water and spray.

title: American Falls in mist
description: The falls seen from water level, a wall of white water dropping onto tumbled boulders with mist rising across the frame.

title: Cascade into the gorge
description: A broad cascade spilling from a layered limestone cliff into vivid turquoise water, green canopy leaning in from above.

title: Sparrow above the gorge
description: A small sparrow perched on a limestone outcrop in the foreground, the turquoise river and far tourist shoreline soft behind it.

title: Niagara panorama
description: The full sweep of the falls from the overlook, spray columns rising between the two cataracts and a tour boat crossing the green water below.

title: Resort pool at dusk
description: A lit resort pool and palm groves seen from above at dusk, the ocean and a band of sunset cloud stretching along the horizon.

title: Autumn reflections
description: Gold and rust autumn trees doubled in a flat lake, warm evening cloud drifting across the reflected sky.

title: Winter cairn
description: A carefully stacked cairn of lichen-mottled stones on leaf litter beside a paved path, bare winter woods rising behind.

title: Winter river
description: A river seen from a bridge in low winter light, bare trees crowding steep clay banks and a sandbar catching the last sun.

title: White barn at sundown
description: A white barn sitting alone at the far edge of a wide green pasture, the sun dropping through bare trees on the right.

title: Spring cascade
description: A creek in early spring running white over a staircase of broad rock shelves, bare grey trunks rising from both banks.

title: Red moss on granite
description: Hard midday sun over a bare granite outcrop scattered with loose stone and patches of red moss, pines low on the horizon.

title: River gorge
description: A shallow river winding through a sandy gorge, spring green on both slopes and a house perched on the ridge above.

title: Spring green
description: A wide river running between steep banks in full spring leaf, red clay and sand exposed along the waterline.

title: Red-tailed hawk
description: A red-tailed hawk gripping a branch and staring straight down at the camera, pale barred breast bright against green leaves and blue sky.

title: Mackerel clouds
description: A dense mackerel sky stretched over a wide granite flat, the sun flaring at the upper right above a distant treeline.

title: Lily pads
description: A pond blanketed in lily pads and duckweed, a clump of rushes standing in the foreground and pines crowding the far bank.

title: Full moon through haze
description: A full moon glowing warm through thin haze, its craters softened and a faint halo bleeding into the black sky.

title: Narrow creek
description: A narrow creek running over pale stones through dense summer woods, exposed roots gripping the undercut banks.

title: Sawgrass island
description: A low island of sawgrass sitting in open water under a bright blue sky and scattered fair-weather cloud.

title: Canal under clouds
description: A straight canal running to the horizon between a wooded bank and open sawgrass, transmission towers marching into the distance.

title: At the sawgrass edge
description: A dense mat of lily pads pressed against a wall of sawgrass, dark water rippling in the foreground.

title: Channel through the pads
description: An open channel of dark water winding between banks of sawgrass and floating lily pads under building cumulus.

title: Lily pad field
description: A broad field of lily pads spreading across still, dark water, bright cumulus stacked above the sawgrass horizon.

title: Roots along the bank
description: A dense row of trees on a low bank, their pale buttressed roots gripping the exposed shoreline above brown water.

title: Gliding through the pads
description: A low, water-level glide alongside dense lily pads and sawgrass, the wake rolling the leaves as the bank slides past.

title: Airboat on the channel
description: An airboat sitting far off on a wide channel, sawgrass banks running away on both sides beneath tall summer cloud.

title: Below the footbridge
description: A summer lake with a low footbridge crossing at the far end, heavy green woods on both banks and grass leaning in from the near shore.

title: Reeds at the lake edge
description: Tall reeds and broad green leaves crowding the near bank of a wooded lake, the footbridge just visible across the water.

title: Sun over the lake
description: The sun high and flaring over a calm lake, a grassy bank and stand of reeds in the foreground and low wooded hills beyond.

title: Autumn river
description: A river running fast over flat rock ledges between banks of yellow autumn foliage, the water catching the low sun upstream.

title: Canyon layers
description: Stacked bands of red and grey rock stepping down into the canyon, a green-topped promontory jutting into the middle distance.

title: Canyon rim
description: A wide view across the canyon under flat grey cloud, terraces receding in cooling shades of rust and slate.

title: Canyon depths
description: Deeply eroded canyon walls dropping away under heavy overcast, red rock at the near rim giving way to grey layers below.

title: Red rock rim
description: Broken red boulders and dry scrub along the rim, the banded canyon opening out beyond under a pale, clouded sky.

title: The river far below
description: The Colorado threading in a thin brown line through the canyon floor, layered cliffs stepping down toward it from the red rim.

title: Colorado through the canyon
description: The river winding between sheer banded walls, folded grey strata filling the middle of the frame below a red rock foreground.

title: Canyon panorama
description: A broad panorama of the canyon under thick grey cloud, distant blue ranges just visible past the far rim.

title: Mountain stream
description: A mountain stream running white over rounded boulders, bare winter trees above and dark evergreen shrub crowding the far bank.

title: Ice curtain
description: A rock face sheathed in thick ice and hanging icicles, rhododendron leaves drooping over the ledge above.

title: Icicles along the ledge
description: A long run of icicles hanging from a mossy rock ledge, the frozen flow spreading out in pale sheets across the ground below.

title: Blue ridges
description: Ridge behind ridge fading into winter haze, a bare pale snag standing in the near frame against the layered blue distance.

title: Red moss basin
description: A shallow basin in a granite outcrop filled with vivid red moss, the bare rock stretching away to a low green treeline.

title: Sandbar on the shoals
description: A curving sandbar along a shallow river running over wide rock shoals, sun flaring through trees at the left edge.

title: Inuksuk
description: A balanced stone figure with outstretched arms standing on bare granite, the horizon of trees running low behind it.

title: Rain pool
description: A shallow rain pool held in a hollow of the granite outcrop, pale lichen ringing its edge and low sun raking the rock.
